product.description: 24"L x 24"W x 20"H Solid pine top with metal frame Industrial, rustic and modern touches come together in a piece that blends with most décor This sturdy piece will last through years of family movie nights and entertaining guests Easy assembly in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This wood and metal end table combines elements of industrial and rustic, allowing it to blend with many styles. The solid pine wood top has a natural distressed finish, while the metal base has modern "x" frames on either end.
